resources.string: SL is not your home app yet
Make SL Launcher Pro your home screen

Android lets you choose which app opens when you press the Home button. SL Launcher Pro only works as your home screen after you select it. You can switch back to your previous launcher at any time in Android Settings.
SL Launcher Pro is your default home app.
Another app is currently your default home app.
If no prompt appears, your phone may have hidden it. Open Android home settings and pick SL Launcher Pro manually.
This device does not expose a default-apps screen. Open Settings › Apps › Default apps manually.
Lets SL Launcher Pro lock the screen when you double-tap the home screen, and open the notification shade when you swipe down. SL does not read your screen or what you type.
